about: Package N221 (2026-10-24, owner N22-1): the Maps 21-40 divvy. homes: every card that waited for a source and its one home (kind pool = applied onto a map that exists; map = a proposed map; quest, secrets (Pack Secrets I), faction, smith, decision (an open owner call), hold (Devilry 66, Ecclesia 77, spells)). maps: the proposed Maps 25-40 (pool = held + carry + unsorted + new ideas; base = the skirmish-base cards). existing: Maps 21-24 after the pass. packTiers: the owner call N221-1. Made by node tools/n221_divvy_2026_10_24.js plan.

25.name: The Rainforest Floor
25.idea: The rainforest main map the Canopy (14-A) points at; the Canopy's held animals live here (RP5).
features: Strange Materia x2 from the boss
Heroic revealed on the main road (bosses field it)

26.name: The Ant Empire
26.idea: A colony the size of a county; the hives' own territory (lore bible: "We", never "I").
ideas: Army Ant Column (a stronger Worker Ant, Pack + Rage)
Meganeura (extinct giant dragonfly, Flying + Quick)
Arthropleura (extinct giant millipede, Armor + Sweep)

27.name: The Carrion Moors
27.idea: Bogs and bones; whatever dies here is eaten. The Gnawed's second home if CONTENT2-3 goes "other sources".
ideas: Cave Hyena (extinct, a stronger Dust Hyena, Executioner + Pack)
Haast's Eagle (extinct giant eagle, Flying + Pounce)
Bog Body Heron (a stronger Mire Witch-Heron, Poison + Nocturnal)

28.name: Stormcoast
28.idea: Cliffs in a gale; seals and seabirds. The Tidefolk's second home if CONTENT2-3 goes "other sources". Pack 5 starts.
ideas: Great Auk (extinct flightless seabird, Tide + Armor)
Steller's Sea Cow (extinct, a stronger Mangrove Manatee, Tide + Regeneration)
Storm Petrel Flock (Flying + Quick)
Thunder-ray (a stronger Electric Ray, Chain Lightning + Tide)

29.name: The Echo Caverns
29.idea: Below Caves & Alcoves, where only sound finds the walls (Sonar, the Hollow Kin).
ideas: Cave Bear Matron (extinct cave bear, Guardian + Regeneration)
Dire Bat Colony (a stronger Vampire Bat, Flying + Swarm)
Olm Elder (a stronger Cave Olm, Regeneration + Darksight)

30.name: The Old Growth
30.idea: Trees older than the war; Evomax opens here (owner: Evomax from Map 30): the sloth line climbs its trunks.
ideas: Megatherium (extinct giant ground sloth: the sloth line's Omega, docs/evolute-design-2026-10-21.md)
Giant Beaver (extinct, the eras list; Lumberjack + Armor)
features: Strange Materia x3 from the boss

31.name: The Hollow Farmsteads
31.idea: The Long Grass grown old: wild cattle and wild horses. Side map: the Cabbage Patch, the owner's Killer Veggies ("people think it's just a farm").
ideas: Aurochs (extinct wild cattle, a stronger Bison Bulldozer)
Tarpan (extinct wild horse, a stronger Stable Colt)
side map: Turnip Brawler, Pumpkin Knight, Snapjaw Flytrap (the Flora note, Maps 20+)

32.name: The Thornwold
32.idea: Thistlewood and the Briar Maze grown wild: the Greenhood Band robs its toll roads, and the Thistle Baron comes back.
ideas: Deinogalerix (extinct giant hedgehog, Thorns + Armor)
Greenhood Outlaw Fox (a stronger Cunning Vixen, Evasive + Bounty)

33.name: The Mammoth Steppe
33.idea: Open frozen grass between the taiga and the ice; the ice-age herds.
ideas: Woolly Rhino (extinct, a stronger Siege Rhino for the cold, Armor + Siege)
Cave Lion (extinct, a stronger Pride Queen, Pack Leader + Pounce)
Steppe Bison (extinct, Pack + Rage)
Irish Elk (extinct Megaloceros, Sweep + Mountain Climber)

34.name: The Tar Pits
34.idea: Black pools that keep what they catch: the predators that came for the trapped. Pack 5 ends.
ideas: Sabre-tooth Stalker (extinct, a stronger Bramblewood Lynx, Pounce + Bleed)
Dire Wolf Pack (extinct, Pack + Rage)
Ground Sloth Wallower (extinct Paramylodon, Guardian + Armor)
Teratorn (extinct giant vulture, Flying + Executioner)

35.name: The Drowned Reef
35.idea: Past Coral Current, where the old things swim. Pack 6 starts.
ideas: Elder Shark (a megalodon look-alike, a stronger Coral Reef Shark)
Serpent Whale (a basilosaurus look-alike, Tide + Pierce)
Dunkleosteus (extinct armoured fish, Armor + Crab Claws)
Ammonite Drifter (extinct, Tide + Armor)

36.name: The Black Bayou
36.idea: Gatorback Swamp grown huge and dark; the Gnawed's rats run its stilt villages.
ideas: Titanoboa (extinct giant snake, Ambush + Poison)
Terror Croc (a deinosuchus look-alike, Ambush + Armor)

37.name: The Lost Isle
37.idea: An island where birds grew big and nothing hunted them, until now.
ideas: Moa Guard (extinct, a stronger Goose Sentry, a Guardian body)
Dodo Steward (extinct, a heavy bird with Bounty)
Elephant Bird (extinct, Armor + Sweep)
Giant Weta (Armor + Pounce)

38.name: The Fossil Badlands
38.idea: Bones in the cliffs; the road's last look at today's world before the dinosaurs (Map 40+).
ideas: Terror Bird (extinct phorusrhacid, Pounce + Speed)
Glyptodont (extinct cart-sized armadillo, Armor + Shield Call)
Megalania (extinct giant monitor, Poison + Rage)

39.name: The Last Savanna
39.idea: Savanna Reaches grown ancient: the giants the hyenas follow.
ideas: Deinotherium (extinct tusked elephant, Siege + Armor)
Sivatherium (extinct giraffe kin, Sweep + Speed)
Chalicotherium (extinct clawed browser, Rage + Armor)

40.name: The Grove of the Dragon-Turtle
40.idea: The boundary: N22-1 builds Maps 40+ one at a time with the owner (idea, work it through, owner confirms, concrete, art). Seed only: the Grovebearer Dragon-Turtle held here (DV5), Legendary revealed, the first world boss of the every-10-maps run, the dinosaur era.
features: a world boss every 10 maps from 40 (docs/progression-2026-10-12.md)
